description: Removed rejected Mattermost branch and bridge-owned file splitting/filtering. Removed uncommitted continuation receipt/history implementation and tests tied to that rejected design. Generic connection details carry settings; existing AdapterOptions maps UI file_max_size to current adapter max_file_size option without provider checks, preserving transport injection. Action reuse: local-only projection using existing create/edit adapter path; no new operation. Focused tests: 71 passed including forwarding for all providers, real Mattermost create/edit and too-many-files rejection. More-than-ten split delivery remains deferred pending adapter contract.
title: Remove Mattermost file planning from shared bridge
